description: What the Qamba Studio window is allowed to ask the Rust side for.

permissions.comment: THE ALLOW-LIST IS THE SECURITY BOUNDARY FOR THIS BUILD. Left at the plugin's default, a node inside an imported ComfyUI workflow could name any URL and the app would fetch it. What is on the list is exactly what a local install needs: the user's own engine on loopback (8189 is the reserved slot for a second one), and the hosts a model download can legitimately come from. PROVIDER API CALLS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT HERE — those go through `secrets::byok_fetch`, which is Rust-side and carries its own per-provider host list, because that is the request that carries the key. Neither is a media host: this build's media is a file in the project's own folder, served by `mediaserver.rs` on loopback and reached by the webview directly.
